teaser.en: A smooth-barked timber tree common in the coast's forests, with leaflets that are lopsided, one side wider than the other.
teaser.sw: Mti wa mbao wenye gome laini unaopatikana kwa wingi katika misitu ya pwani, wenye vijani vilivyopinda, upande mmoja mpana kuliko mwingine.

summary.en: *Mkuwa* is a buttressed, smooth-barked tree of coastal woodland and forest, and one of the common coastal forest trees used for timber.
summary.sw: *Mkuwa*, au mkue, ni mti wenye mizizi-ukuta na gome laini wa misitu ya wazi na misitu ya pwani, na ni mojawapo ya miti ya kawaida ya msitu wa pwani inayotumika kwa mbao.

about.en: *Mkuwa* usually has a buttressed trunk and smooth grey bark. The leaves have two or three pairs of leaflets, and each leaflet is asymmetric, with one side wider than the other. The fruits are oblong pods, as in other members of the bean family.
about.sw: Kwa kawaida *mkuwa* una shina lenye mizizi-ukuta na gome laini la kijivu. Majani yake yana jozi mbili au tatu za vijani, na kila kijani hakina ulinganifu, upande mmoja ukiwa mpana kuliko mwingine. Matunda yake ni maganda marefu, kama ilivyo kwa mimea mingine ya jamii ya kunde.

where.en: It grows in *Brachystegia* woodland, along the edges of creeks, and in evergreen and riverine forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika misitu ya wazi ya *Brachystegia*, kando ya mikondo ya bahari, na katika misitu ya kijani kibichi na ya kando ya mito.

uses.en: *Mkuwa* is one of the common coastal forest trees, and it is used as timber.
uses.sw: *Mkuwa* ni mojawapo ya miti ya kawaida ya msitu wa pwani, na hutumika kwa mbao.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mkuwa* and *ukwe*; the ICRAF handbook gives *mkue*. In Swahili it is *mkue* or *mukuwa*, and in Giriama *msahe*. The Swahili *mkue* is also used for *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*, which the Digo call *mrihi* or *mukwe*, so these names overlap between trees.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkuwa* na *ukwe*; kitabu cha ICRAF kinatoa *mkue*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkue* au *mukuwa*, na kwa Kigiriama *msahe*. Jina la Kiswahili *mkue* pia linatumika kwa *Paramacrolobium coeruleum*, ambao Wadigo huuita *mrihi* au *mukwe*, hivyo majina haya yanaingiliana kati ya miti.

reason.en: Brachystegia, the woodland it grows in
reason.sw: Brachystegia, msitu wa wazi unaoota ndani yake
Mti mwingine wa mbao wa msituni

reason.en: Major timber tree of the same family
reason.sw: Mti mkuu wa mbao wa familia moja
